chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Agrippa in, “Nang in nang ading na gen thei ding hi,” a cih ciangin Paul in a khut zanin a gen-inah:
“Agrippa Kumpipa aw, nangma mai-ah Judah mite in hong mawhsakna kiphelna thu, tuni-in gen thei ding ka hih ciangin ka nuam hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in Judah ngeina thu leh thu kidotna khempeuh na siam hi. Tua ahih ciangin dam takin ka thu na ngai ta in.
“Jerusalem khua sungah ka mipawlte lakah ka om lai takin, ka neu lai pan akipan ka omzia leh ka hihnate Judah mi khempeuh in a thei uh hi.
Judah ngeina tel takpi a zui pen pawl Farisai mi ka hihna hih mite in teci a pan’ nop uh leh, a thei masa bel ahi uh hi.
Tu-in Pasian in i pute i pate kiangah a piak thu kiciamna lametna hanginah thukhenna thuakin ka om hi.
Judah mipawl sawm-le-nihte in sun leh zanin hahkatin Pasian bia-in, thu kiciamna bangin ngah ding a lamen uh hi. Kumpipa aw, hih lametna hangin Judah mite in hong mawhsak uh hi.
Pasian in misite a thokiksak ding hi cih thu up theih ding hilo hi ci-in bang hangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
“Nazareth khua mi Zeisu’ min langpanin ahi thei zahzaha sep ding mah hi ci-in ka kizo khin a,
Jerusalem khua-ah tua bangin ka hih zo hi. Siampi liante kiang pan thu ka ngah khit ciangin misiangthote thong sungah ka khia hi. Amaute in sihna a thuak uh ciangin ka thukim hi.
Mite in Pasian tungah a pau khialh nadingin thatang hat thu-in hanciamin, kikhopna inn khat pan khat ah tamveipi ka pai hi. Nakpi-in ka heh maninah gamdangte khua dongin amaute ka bawlsia hi.
“Tua ahih ciangin siampi liante thupiakna leh lai pua-in Damaskas khua lampi ka pai lai takin,
ni sangin a tangzaw, kei leh kei tawh hong paikhawmte kimkot ah hong taang, sun lai takin vantung pan khuavak khat ka mu hi, Kumpipa aw,
Kote khempeuh in lei tungah ka puk lai takun, ‘Saul aw, Saul aw, bang hangin hong bawlsia na hi hiam? Ciang hiam na khe tawh peek leteh a haksa hi,’ ci-in Hebru kamin a hong ci aw khat ka za hi.
‘Topa aw, nang kua na hi hiam?’ ci-in ka dot leh, ‘Na hong bawlsiat Zeisu ka hi hi.
Ahih hangin tho in ding in, Judah mite leh Gentail mite khut sung pan nang hong gumkhia a, nang in na muhsa thute leh a nung ciangin kei in nang kiangah kong kilatsak ding thute,
hilh a, teci-a pang za-ah nang kong koih nadingin nang kiangah ka hong kilang zo hi.

Tua Gentailte in khuamial sung pan khuavak lamah galkah a, Satan’ ukna pan Pasian kiangah kihei ding a, mawhna kimaisakna a ngah ding uh a, kei hong up manunah sian’thosakna a ngahsa mite tawh luahna a ngah khawm nadingun, amau mittang uh na hon’sak dingin, amau kiangah kong paisak ding hi,’ ci-in thu hong pia hi.
“Tua ahih ciangin Agrippa Kumpipa aw, vantung mangmuhna ngai loin ka om kei hi.

Amaute kisikkik a, kisikkikna tawh kilawm gamtatna bawlin Pasian kiangah a kihei na’ngun Damaskas khua-ah ka gen masak khit ciangin Jerusalem khua akipan Judah gamah a om mi khempeuh kiangah ahi zongin, Gentailte kiangah ahi zongin ka hilh hi.
Tua thu hangin Judah mite in biakna innpi sungah kei hong man uh a, hong thah nading uh a hahkat uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian kiang panin huhna ka ngah khit ciangin tuni dongin ka om a,

Khazih in sihna thuak ding a, sihna pan a thokik masabel ahih ciangin, Judah mipawl leh Gentailte kiangah khuavakna thu a piang ding hi ci-in Moses akipan Pasian’ kamsangte’ thugenna mah kei in behlap loin milian, mineute kiangah teci-in ka pang hi,” a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin Paul in mawhna kiphelhna thu a gen lai takin Festas in, “Paul aw, nang mihai bang na hi hi! Lungpilna tam sinin, mihai na suak zo hi,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko hi.
Paul in, “Mangpa Festas aw, ka hai kei hi. Thuman leh sanhuai thute ka gen hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih leh, kumpipa mai-ah ka gen ngam hih thute kumpipa in a thei hi. Hih thu a thei lo khat beek a om kei hi ci-in ka sin sungah ka um hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, hih thute a kilang lo-na munah kibawl ahi kei hi.
Kumpipa Agrippa aw, nang in kamsangte thu um na hi hiam? Na um cih ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Agrippa in, “Nang in zolna thu tawm tawh kei Christian nong suaksak dektak hi,” ci-in Paul kiangah a ci hi.

Paul in, “Nang akipan tuni-in ka thu a za khempeuh in hih sikkol sim lohin, thu tam tawh ahi zongin, thu tawm tawh ahi zongin, kei tawh kibang na suah theih nadingun Pasian kiangah thu ka ngen hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa leh Bernike, mangpipa leh amau tawh a tukhawmte a ding uh a,
a paikhiat khit uh ciangin, “Hih mi in sih nading ahi zongin, kikhum nading ahi zongin a bawl kei hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Agrippa in, “Tua pa in, ‘Kaisar kumpipa kiangah azu ka khan ding hi,’ ci hi kei leh, a khah tuak hi,” ci-in Festas kiangah a ci hi.
